summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was hot-reloaded from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable. The worker marked orders processed without payment, and the failures were logged only at DEBUG. The change was not in the deploy history.
recommended: Find out who changed payment_provider_url to payments-v2 and whether the v2 endpoint is valid.
Log provider failures at ERROR and alert on them.
Don't mark an order processed when its payment fails.
Validate provider reachability before applying a config change.
